acceptance_criteria.criterion: VARIABLES.md does not list wp_id as a current template variable
Per-template matrix shows no template using wp_id, wp-scope-reminder, begin-work-developer, or scope-restriction
Partial catalogue lists exactly project-path-reminder.md and pm-preamble.md
Document is internally consistent with the actual template files

summary: VARIABLES.md already reflects the simplified template system as implemented in WP-001. All four acceptance criteria are satisfied by the existing document: wp_id is absent from the variable table, the per-template matrix contains no references to wp_id/wp-scope-reminder/begin-work-developer/scope-restriction, the partial catalogue lists exactly project-path-reminder.md and pm-preamble.md, and the document is internally consistent with the actual template files on disk (verified by inspecting all 8 templates and the partials/ directory).

comments.note: VARIABLES.md was rewritten as part of the WP-001 implementation pipeline (combined with template and node changes), so no separate edits were required in this documentation pass. The document accurately describes the simplified variable matrix, the 2-entry partial catalogue, and the pm-preamble nesting constraint.
